> Could you point the direction, how to fix it?

https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/pull/34329/commits/c00e781193cf21cfd7fa146cb6307a89ee99f829 should fix it. In UI mode we run the plugins once in `runGlobalSetup`, but every call to `_loadConfigOrReportError` returns a new instance of `FullConfigInternal`, which resulted in new metadata instance being created every time. User config is cached between the calls as we use Node's `require()` to load it. Now that we always read the metadata object from `userConfig.metadata`, it should also be reused between `_loadConfigOrReportError` invocations.

comments: We discussed this issue, and are not sure how to improve it.
